limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Ranked verified defense-policy/order state changes: US Iraq withdrawal, Israeli aid cut shock, $1.5T budget standoff, Turkey-Pakistan-Saudi pact, Hanwha missile tests, NZ Starshield trial, Iron Gate operation, munitions demand. Excluded sports/thesis 'defense' homonyms.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Selected authoritative macro data/policy signals: strong US jobs vs Fed, Hungary GDP contraction, Philippines weaker GDP, unemployment data, IMF Nigeria investment, World Bank Kenya warning, Bangladesh debt, Pakistan reform call. Excluded stale-dated items and stock picks.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Prioritized physical supply disruptions (Khor Mor, Iran war export losses, Red Sea shipping risk), verified corporate supply deals (ADNOC-TotalEnergies LNG), trade/embargo actions, and confirmed price moves; excluded stock-picking and lifestyle gas-price pieces.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Only five distinct material events exist in this theme; prioritized sovereign default deadline, systemic risk survey, borrower-stress loan slowdown, liquidity build-up and sovereign-debt vigilance. Excluded fraud/personal finance noise.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Ranked verified legal/policy state changes: Oregon/four-state Medicaid work-requirement suits, Florida notice ruling, $100M fraud settlement, FDA gene-therapy probe, CMS directory rules, Medicaid expansion politics, and coverage-loss warnings.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Ranked verified state changes: Khor Mor gasfield attack halting supply (corroborated across themes), Russia's deadly drone strikes on Ukraine, Iran-war de-escalation signaling moving oil markets, Saudi/Houthi strikes on oil infrastructure, DPRK war-prep orders, US sanctions on Canadian firms, Hamas-Fatah declaration, Philippines missile procurement. Excluded speculation, opinion, sports and unrelated items.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Ranked verifiable policy/rate actions and inflation prints with global transmission: BoE hike, China PPI surge, BOJ commentary, IMF warning, Ethiopia hold, PBOC shift, hot US inflation market reaction, Philippines hike expectations. Excluded retirement/personal-finance and stock tips.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Ranked verified disruptive events: Japan earthquake (corroborated), US shutdown deal, Afghanistan quake, Colorado preemptive power cuts, Georgia midterm political shift, Gaza winter-storm flooding, Gambia election, German student strike. Excluded dated/duplicative wildfire retrospectives.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Ranked material bullion signals: China 24th reserve build, Goldman forecast cut, election-driven gold/silver jump, Fed-hike-capped price action, India gold-loan surge, Liberia refining plan, mine eviction. Excluded sports, jewelry and homonym 'gold/silver' noise.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Ranked verified capex/contract/foundry state changes (Google $17B Wyoming, Samsung plant, Intel-Amazon chip, Anthropic power deal, Nvidia Arm PC, Microsoft protest, 800V grid) with material grid/infrastructure signals. Excluded stock picks and tagged topic pages.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Ranked material trade-policy state changes: Supreme Court tariff rejection, Canada 100% China EV tariff, US China tariff exclusions extension, Norway salmon penalty removal, and major policy standoffs; excluded local dairy/salmon anecdotes and opinion.
